Shell: denied by default, denied when enabled but not allowlisted, allowed when enabled+allowlisted, and 5 always-deny commands (rm, git commit, sudo, curl, git push) denied even when explicitly present in the allowlist. grep confirmed zero subprocess usage in the module (docstring mention only).
